04.caption: The network page shows who runs this node, the head of its record log and its timestamp and replication status.
04.heading: The network page

05.alt: Step 2, Details, of the submit wizard: the title and abstract filled in and the categories cs.AI and cs.LG chosen
05.caption: Step 2: give the title, abstract and categories, as they should be cited.
05.heading: Step 2: Details

05.heading: Step 5: Sign

05.heading: After you submit: the status tracker

05.caption: A co-author reads the version on this page, then accepts or declines being named on it.

06.heading: 4. Fill the rubric

06.caption: A committed review is sealed. It can be revealed once a second review is committed, or after the waiting period.
06.heading: 5. Commit the review (sealed)

06.heading: 7. Author replies

06.caption: When a new version is listed, update your review. The new scores are public at once; the written report follows the version's gate.
06.heading: 8. Update your review for a new version

07.heading: Who can take part

09.heading: For moderators: the console
